question: Which of the following was the last Five-Year Plan in India before its replacement with NITI Aayog?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12th Five-Year Plan 2012-2017**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Five-year plans** are development plans in India that are formulated by the government to achieve various socio-economic objectives over a period of five years.
 
• The **12th five-year plan was implemented from 2012-2017**, with the aim of achieving inclusive growth, enhancing social development, and promoting sustainable development.
 
 
• It was the **last five year plan in India.**
 
• **It **Control **macroeconomic imbalances, reverse slowdown, and push for structural reforms**
